body:
I've been to the edge of the universe and back with several substances over the years, especially DXM,  and I figured it was time to try yopo.  In the months before this experience, I attempted ayahuasca brews, HBWoodrose, and amanitas, and I didn't get anywhere.
When I got home from work one night, I roasted ten seeds in a pan till they swelled and cracked on medium-low heat. I tried my best to peel them and separate the nut meats from the flakey shell. I then ground the meats in my mortar and pestle and added a smaller than pea sized amount of edible lime to the powder that I bought from an indian grocery store. I also added a pinch of baking soda and two drops of water.
I kneaded this mixture into a doughy ball for about five min. It was about the size of a marble.  I flattened it into a pancake and placed it on top of a mason jar lid, which was the only chunk of metal I could find.  I held a lighter under it for a few seconds and it dried extremely fast. It was like hardened play-dough. I ground it in my mortar again and lined it up in two lines, one for each nostril.
Nothing could have prepared me for the pain. I used a piece of a straw to snort it. I got 3/4 of each line into each nostril as I fell to my knees groaning and writhing in the most terrible pain. Even after reading other's reports I truly misunderstood how much this would hurt. I've snorted everything under the sun and felt varying degrees of what I thought was serious discomfort, but nothing compared to this. However it only lasted about 15 seconds.
I also wasn't prepared for how intense of a trip it was. Two minutes after the pain I felt like I was blacking out.
I also wasn't prepared for how intense of a trip it was. Two minutes after the pain I felt like I was blacking out.
I was fighting to stay conscious. On top of that I had to concentrate on breathing. I breathed very deep and slow and I felt like if I didn't think about it I just wouldn't happen. I ran to the toilet to puke and dry heaved and just collapsed in front of the toilet.  This is where I remained for another hour.
The visuals began as I was dry heaving. They were intense cliché psychedelic blue green and yellow lava lamp colors everywhere. If I stared at something for a few seconds it began to stretch and warp, namely the toilet.  As I stared into the toilet lid, the visuals got deeper. I was scared to close my eyes. I heard confused whispers everywhere that sounded like my mom telling me what not to look at or how not to sit. I remained nauseous the entire time, though I didnt want to puke because I knew it wouldnt make me feel better.  I finally looked to the left of my toilet into the blue wall and saw what looked like a map of blood vessels with tiny cars driving through them.  This eventually came out of the wall and floated in a block of electric ice near my head.  During this time I was communicating with the snorted seeds inside me, begging them not to make me puke and to take the blacking out feeling away.
The closed eye visuals were more than I could take, so I avoided them. The first few times I held my eyes closed it was as if there were lightspeed image TVs behind my eyelids. It was too much. After sitting and drooling on myself for about 20 min, the effects lessened enough for me to enjoy them.  The extreme CEVs turned into a high speed tunnel trip I was too scared to take, though I felt something may be at the end of it.  I didnt move from my sitting position in front of the toilet for an hour. I was finally able to stand an hour later and I felt 100 feet tall. I gradually came down and experienced an incredible after glow.
The strange thing about this trip is the fear. Ive never felt fear on any trip.  It physically sucked as well, but the things I saw were totally worth it. I wasnt prepared because so many reports made it seem like not much would happen. Im definitely going to try again.
